csharpRazorTagHelpers.suppressCompletion.description: Suppress Tag Helper completions when the cursor is inside a double-quoted string (including C# verbatim strings like @"...").

csharpRazorTagHelpers.autoTriggerEnumVal.description: Automatically trigger completion for enum-based attribute values when typing opening quotes (e.g. layout-type="...").

csharpRazorTagHelpers.showWhatsNewOnUpda.description: Open What's New (the GitHub changelog) after installing or updating the extension.

csharpRazorTagHelpers.enableFolding.description: Enable folding of Tag Helper elements in Razor files, including multi-line opening tags (e.g. a <grid> whose select attribute spans many lines of SQL).

csharpRazorTagHelpers.diagnostics.enable.description: Show Tag Helper warnings in Razor files (unknown attributes, ParentTag, closing tags, duplicate attributes).

csharpRazorTagHelpers.diagnostics.unknow.description: Warn about attributes that are not properties of the current Tag Helper (HTML/aria/data/asp-* attributes are ignored).

csharpRazorTagHelpers.diagnostics.parent.description: Warn when a Tag Helper is used outside its HtmlTargetElement ParentTag (e.g. <filter> outside <filters-group>).

csharpRazorTagHelpers.diagnostics.closin.description: Warn about missing, mismatched, or unexpected closing tags for discovered Tag Helpers.

csharpRazorTagHelpers.diagnostics.duplic.description: Warn when the same attribute appears more than once on a Tag Helper element.

csharpRazorTagHelpers.insertFullTagSnipp.description: When completing a Tag Helper element name, insert a full <tag>...</tag> snippet instead of only the tag name.

csharpRazorTagHelpers.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inlay hints for Tag Helper elements and attributes in Razor files.

csharpRazorTagHelpers.inlayHints.showPro.description: Show the C# property name next to each Tag Helper attribute (e.g. select → Select).

csharpRazorTagHelpers.inlayHints.showTyp.description: Show the C# property type next to each Tag Helper attribute (e.g. : bool, : string).

csharpRazorTagHelpers.inlayHints.showCla.description: Show the Tag Helper class name next to the element name (e.g. grid → : GridTagHelper).

csharpRazorTagHelpers.sqlHighlighting.en.description: Highlight SQL inside configured Tag Helper attribute values.

csharpRazorTagHelpers.sqlHighlighting.ru.description: Which Tag Helper elements and attributes get SQL highlighting. tag can be a helper name (e.g. grid) or * for any element. attributes is a list of kebab-case names, or * for every attribute of that tag.

tag.description: Tag Helper element name, or * for any.

attributes.description: Attribute names (kebab-case). Use * for all attributes of that tag.

colors.description: SQL keyword inside Tag Helper attributes
SQL comment inside Tag Helper attributes
SQL string inside Tag Helper attributes
SQL number inside Tag Helper attributes

scripts.test: node test/folding.test.js && node test/definition.test.js && node test/sql.test.js && node test/outline-diagnostics.test.js && node test/inlayHints.test.js && node test/whatsNew.test.js
